about.title: Pomona Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Getting around Pomona usually means the San Bernardino Freeway or the surface streets that carry the rest of the traffic: Garey Avenue, Mission Boulevard and Holt Avenue. Those four corridors show up most often in the city's public collision records. In 2025, the last year with final numbers, Pomona logged 1,003 injury collisions, 1,428 people injured and 16 traffic deaths. Reports tend to cluster on Fridays between 5 and 7 p.m., when the I-10 is at its heaviest and the evening commute is under way. If one of those crashes was yours, you may already be fielding calls from an adjuster while still sorting out a rental car and follow-up appointments. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We listen to what happened and connect you with an independent personal injury attorney who handles Los Angeles County car accident claims on contingency. Being connected costs nothing, and the attorney only earns a fee if there is a recovery. Whether to hire remains your call.

items.title: Deadlines that vary by defendant
items.desc: California gives most crash victims two years to file, but a claim involving a city vehicle, Caltrans or another public agency can require notice in as little as six months. Getting connected early keeps those options open.

items.title: Partial fault does not close the door
items.desc: Under pure comparative fault, you can still recover even if you were partly to blame, with the amount reduced by your share. That matters on busy roads like Holt or Mission where blame is often shared.

items.title: No cap, no fee up front
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages in ordinary car accident cases, and network attorneys work on contingency. You owe nothing to be connected and no attorney fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The other driver's insurer wants a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other side a recorded statement, and it is usually wise to wait until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters may use small inconsistencies to argue you were more at fault than you were. Keep your own notes and photos instead, and let a lawyer handle the conversation.

items.question: I was rear-ended on the I-10 near Pomona but wasn't hurt badly at first. Do I still have a claim?
items.answer: Many freeway injuries, especially to the neck and back, show up a day or two later. See a doctor promptly and keep every record, including the CHP report number if officers responded. Two years is the general filing window in California, but evidence such as dashcam footage and witness contacts fades much faster.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge me anything?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service and not a law firm. The independent attorney you are connected with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless your case results in a recovery, and you decide whether to hire them.
